description: Convert subtitles. Turn SRT into VTT and back, and shift the timings while you are at it. Runs in your browser — it is text, nothing needs a server. Accepts .srt, .vtt, text/vtt, text/plain, application/x-subrip; up to 5 MB per file.

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

shiftMs.description: Shift every cue by this many milliseconds. Negative moves them earlier

name: text_subtitles
